about_the_game:
In this demo you can appreciate a fresh combination of alchemy and city builder. Choose your building options with the recipes you need. Produce resources. Satisfy the needs of your citizens. Develop your city. Grow.

How to play

You produce resources to throw them into the rift and get spawn orbs at the beginning of the night, and also some resource orbs. If the resource is marked at the top of the screen - you will also get progress in research points that could be used to discover new buildings.

Spawn orbs could be used to spawn buildings that will bring new opportunities to produce resources, feed people and dump surplus into the rift.

Note that buildings get fragility from usage (mainly transmutation and work with units). Buildings could be repaired if you discover an obelisk, prefecture or contraption with such functionality. Or repair could be made with recipes using demonite, if the building has one.

To produce resources, you can:

- run a building recipe

- place a squad on top of a building before the end of the turn (if there is suitable one)

- assign people to work in a building that can use resource nodes or other buildings around it (hover over the gold buttons on the left of the building panel)

TURNS

The turn is ended by recipes without delay (an arrow instead of a clock with the number of turns) and by putting resources in cubes and elite spheres (a gold icon above them).

Also during the game you accumulate Time Freeze charges. They can be used to not move time with those actions that usually move it.

GOLD

To obtain gold you could collect taxes. The efficiency of tax collection depends on the population, bliss and TaxMod of the dwellings they live in. Beware that tax collecting lowers the bliss of people.

From time to time there will be trading ships arriving at your settlement. They buy one specific resource at a certain price and sell several packs of resources for bulk price.

ISLAND EXPLORATION

You can buy enorbs in encampment on the shore. Enorbs are needed to open cubes and spheres of darkness. You can only take one enorb per turn. A cube opens with one orb and a sphere with three orbs. After opening, you will need to put the required resources into it and get a reward.

The cube will give you gold, demonite and will clear a place on the island. The sphere will remove its influence and open the territory and resource nodes hidden behind the darkness. Be careful with the spheres - threats with a timer appear from them, they will cause harm every X turns.

BANDITS and SQUADS

Every night the settlement will be attacked by bandit troops. Their number will increase if you have a lot of gold during the day.

All squads have a radius and charges. Friendly squads spend charges on work, except for the sorceress. The sorceress and bandit squads spend charges on attacks. When the charges run out, the squad disbands.

Squads perform their actions in their radius. Friendly squads will do nothing if there is no target for their action in their radius. Hostile squads will move towards their target in a specified direction until it gets into the radius. Friendly squads always perform their action before hostiles.

MISC

Every day in the morning there will be an order from people, determining the shape of some buildings. You should fulfill their order to raise the bliss of the population.

The more buildings you have - the more hostile squads will arrive and the more buildings will be ordered by people in the morning. The more turns have passed - the more fragility your actions will add to the buildings, and also the more hostile squads will arrive.

NOTE

Paying tribute with demonite, full functionality of the rift, forging the sphere crown and the final confrontation (as well as a more detailed description of the systems) I will provide in the demo update later.

Thank you very much for trying to understand the game.

Give feedback in the community section - it will be very helpful.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-530 / AMD Phenom II X4 965
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Play alchemy by building a city and meeting the needs of the population. Extract matter from demonic rift and transform it into a resource. Explore your paths of transmutation. Exploit the synergy of systems to save the visiting deity. Protect it from corporate fools who do not see its power.
